title: Dissect a Transformer Block
core_invariant: A transformer block is attention plus residual, a declared pre-norm convention, and a position-wise feed-forward. Multi-head attention is parallel projections, not human job titles. Residual connections are matching-shape adds of stream plus sublayer. Pre-norm versus post-norm is an architecture convention, not a vibe. The FFN does not mix positions. Named checkpoints catch the first residual or norm divergence. Predict before every block action. LLM training and inference policy stay closed. Generic WP-137 trace, table, and metric blocks carry the evidence; there is no custom frontend.

stages.title: Frame one pre-norm teaching block
stages.instructions: Restate the M29 single-head trace. M30's whole is a tiny pre-norm block: LN → multi-head attention → W_O + residual, then LN → position-wise FFN + residual, on a deterministic 4-D sequence (river bank cash). Identify gate evidence: a WP-137 named-checkpoint trace, a residual-identity metric, and a head-concat table. Do not train an LLM or set a decoding policy. The generic workbench renders catalogue blocks; do not expect a named transformer page.

stages.title: Predict, run the block, and trace named checkpoints
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the declared pre-norm block. (1) PREDICT the residual identity stream+sublayer, that concat reconstructs merged heads, and that an FFN activation change leaves the attention residual untouched. (2) COMMIT the prediction. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the teaching block; emit WP-137 blocks: a trace of TRACE_CHECKPOINTS, a table of shapes (B,T,D) / (B,T,H,d_head) / (B,T,d_ff), and a metric of attn_add matching stream+sublayer. (4) OBSERVE the structured trace. (5) SUBMIT an explanation of any delta. Compare labeled post-norm on the same weights without calling either universal. Do not assign linguistic roles to heads.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; the submitted explanation covers the observed trace and why later-mission mechanisms stayed closed.

stages.title: Read split, M29 call, merge, W_O, residual, LN, FFN
stages.instructions: Read head split, the trusted M29 attention call, merge/concat, output projection, residual that uses the original stream in pre-norm, position-wise FFN, declared convention label. Predict shapes and the residual identity. Do not inspect an M31 trainer. Submit an annotated system-flow artifact.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: The trace names the teaching dataflow and does not open later-mission internals.

stages.title: Diagnose a wrong residual branch or misplaced norm
stages.instructions: One named fault: add attention to LN(x) rather than to x, or skip the pre-attention LayerNorm while still labeling the run pre_norm. Predict which named checkpoint diverges first. Execute, emit a WP-137 table of first_divergence, and repair residual addend or first-norm boundary from the broken trace. Parameters and input stay fixed. Submit prediction, discriminator, smallest repair, and regression.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each failure names one controlled cause; the repair restores the named contract.

stages.title: Trace a block without assistance
stages.instructions: From a blank page, draw the pre-norm diagram, compute (1,0,2)+(0,1,-1)=(1,1,1), name the wrong-placement call, and list what M29 owns inside the block. Tutor surfaces stay locked. Emit a WP-137 metric of independent residual arithmetic. Leave learner answers unfilled in the repository.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Independent no-AI reasoning names the teaching contract and a valid repair.

stages.title: Author the V06 teaching-block convention ADR
stages.instructions: Author the block convention ADR: pre- versus post-norm, activation, head dims, checkpointed intermediates, version identity, alternatives, owner, status, and date. Do not make LLM-training claims.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR names a teaching-scale decision, alternatives, and a revisit trigger.

stages.title: Hand M31 a block dataflow map
stages.instructions: Connect the accepted pre-norm block to V06: convention label, shapes, residual identities, observability points. M31 may wrap a training objective only after this map is defensible. Do not retrain the block here.

stages.title: Evaluate transformer-block evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, checkpoint-trace experiment, residual/norm failure, unassisted transfer, and ADR against the gate contract. Issue PASSED or targeted repair. Do not award completion from head mythology.
